## Claim revision · L1 REWORK round 1 on PR #34910 · 2026-11-17T16:01Z

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Why: PR #34910 (head af88513510) aligns the reads to the spec sentence in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` (~399-403: "Absent, the canonical member … naming the canonical value is the same request … a well-formed member with nothing stored or shipped answers as that door answers an absent item"). For a bundle with no canonical member, the read naming no member moves from 200 (another member) to 404. That narrows a served answer. The precedent of the same class, PR #34644 (#34441), took `!` and registered an ADR-0087 semantic entry (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.shipped-base-dependent-canonical-row-not-published.ts`). This card follows it: the dev's open question, option A.

File surface (revised): adds `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-bundle-member-one-request.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` (the `/published` door is runtime-owned; the old cell-1 pin asserted the old answer), and one new semantic entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` with the generated registry outputs it moves.

Owed before the queue: the dogfood battery on the final head (`(narrowing)` arm) and a contract-review-tier L2 record (a narrowing, and the `packages/spec/src/**` path arm).
